title.vi: 1. Một marketplace thời gian thực, không chỉ map dots
title.en: 1. A real-time marketplace beyond map dots

paragraphs.vi: Ta xây dịch vụ ride-hailing lấy Uber làm ngữ cảnh: rider nhận quote và request; hệ thống tìm driver, tạo offer, commit accept, theo dõi trip, complete/cancel và phát payment/receipt events. Bài chọn non-pooling, một driver tối đa một active trip. Pooling, courier nhiều jobs và airport queues là extension có constraints khác, không được áp invariant đơn giản này lên tất cả sản phẩm.
paragraphs.en: We build ride-hailing in an Uber-like product context: quotes, requests, candidates, offers, acceptance, trip progress, cancellation/completion and payment/receipt events. This chapter assumes non-pooling with at most one active trip per driver. Pooling, multi-job couriers and airport queues require different constraints.

paragraphs.vi: Các công bố công khai về H3, domain-oriented architecture và transactional fulfillment cho thấy nhiều bài toán đã thay đổi qua thời gian. Kiến trúc dưới đây là bài học tổng hợp do AV Lore biên soạn; không khẳng định stack/topology hiện tại của Uber hoặc số traffic thật. Các stages xếp theo pressure để học; không bắt một startup phải đi qua mọi công nghệ trong cùng thứ tự.
paragraphs.en: Public work on H3, domain-oriented architecture and transactional fulfillment illustrates changing pressures. The architecture below is AV Lore’s teaching synthesis, not a claim about current private topology or real traffic. Stages follow learning pressures rather than a mandatory startup technology sequence.

items.vi: Location/ETA/candidates cần fresh, bounded latency và biết khi stale.
items.en: Locations, ETAs and candidates need freshness, bounded latency and explicit staleness.

items.vi: Trip/reservation/command results cần consistency, recovery và unique effects.
items.en: Trips, reservations and results need consistency, recovery and unique effects.

items.vi: Total wait, tail wait, acceptance, fairness và supply coverage có thể xung đột.
items.en: Total wait, tails, acceptance, fairness and coverage can conflict.

title.vi: 2. Viết invariants trước khi vẽ matching

paragraphs.vi: Một trip có tối đa một committed driver trong flow này; một driver có tối đa một active reservation/trip. Current offer phải thuộc trip, driver session, generation và chưa expiry; accepted command retry trả result cũ cho cùng logical intent. Trip CAS chỉ trên một row bảo vệ invariant đầu nhưng không bảo vệ invariant thứ hai khi driver nhận hai trip IDs khác nhau. Enforce cả hai trong một transaction nếu placement/isolation cho phép, hoặc protocol reservation/fencing có semantics tương đương.
paragraphs.en: One trip has at most one committed driver; one driver has at most one active reservation/trip. Offers bind trips, sessions, generations and expiry; repeated logical acceptance returns retained results. A CAS on one trip protects that trip but not a driver across two trip IDs. Use supported atomic transactions or equivalent reservation/fencing protocols.

paragraphs.vi: Requested → offered → assigned → arriving → in-progress → completed/canceled là một illustrative lifecycle, không mọi transition đều hợp lệ từ mọi state. Cancellation, offer expiry và completion có competing commands; use expected versions và retained command outcomes. Release driver chỉ khi reservation owner/token match; một delayed cancel không được giải phóng driver đã gán trip mới.
paragraphs.en: A teaching lifecycle moves through requested, offered, assigned, arriving, in-progress and completed/canceled with guarded transitions. Cancellation, expiry and completion can race, so use expected versions and retained outcomes. Release only matching reservation ownership; delayed cancellation must not free a driver reassigned to another trip.

title.vi: 3. 12 giai đoạn: đổi thiết kế theo bottleneck
title.en: 3. 12 stages: change design under measured pressure

paragraphs.vi: Chạy các giai đoạn để tách hot path khỏi durable core, rồi xem vì sao cần recovery, contracts, tracing, streams, ML và domain boundaries. Mỗi bước có problem/decision/trade-off/exit criteria. Driver location, trip history và payment không dùng chung durability/freshness contract chỉ vì đều mang trip ID.
paragraphs.en: Trace stages from hot paths and durable cores to recovery, contracts, tracing, streams, ML and domains. Each stage explains pressures, decisions, trade-offs and exit criteria. Sharing a trip ID does not make location, history and payments share durability/freshness contracts.

title.en: One app and one trip authority

description.vi: MVP cho một vùng nhỏ: rider tạo request, driver cập nhật availability/location, app tạo offer và accept thành trip. Một modular application và relational store có thể đủ; spatial index giúp tránh full-table scan. Định nghĩa non-pooling trong bài này: driver có tối đa một active trip. Trip và driver reservation phải nhất quán, còn displayed map dots chỉ là projection.
description.en: Start in a small region: riders request, drivers report availability/locations, offers become trips. One modular app and relational store may suffice; spatial indexing avoids scans. This chapter assumes non-pooling, with at most one active trip per driver. Trips and reservations need consistency; map dots are projections.

problem.vi: Nhóm nhỏ cần chứng minh end-to-end booking/accept/cancel hoạt động và debug được.
problem.en: A small team needs working, debuggable request, acceptance and cancellation.

decision.vi: Modular API, transactional trip/driver state, scoped command IDs và bounded notification.
decision.en: Use modular APIs, transactional trip/driver state, scoped command IDs and bounded notification.

tradeoff.vi: GPS writes có thể tranh IO/CPU với trip transactions; một deploy có broad blast radius.
tradeoff.en: GPS writes compete with trip transactions and releases have broad impact.

nextPressure.vi: Location traffic hoặc dispatch latency vượt SLO đã đo, không chỉ vì số cities tăng.
nextPressure.en: Measured location or dispatch limits exceed SLOs, not merely more cities.

exitCriteria.vi: Retries không tạo hai trips; simultaneous accepts không double-book driver/trip; cancel có version rõ.
exitCriteria.en: Retries do not create duplicate trips; concurrent accepts respect both uniqueness constraints and versioned cancellation.

caption.vi: Schema đơn giản vẫn cần indexes, transactions và recovery; relational không đồng nghĩa scan mọi driver.
caption.en: Simple schemas still need indexes, transactions and recovery; relational storage does not imply scanning every driver.

description.vi: Giữ latest-position projection tối ưu cho dispatch, có server-issued session epoch, sequence và freshness. Durable trip/driver reservation không bị thay bởi cache eligibility. History dùng cho billing, safety hoặc disputes cần pipeline/retention riêng; “location cache có thể rebuild” không có nghĩa mọi location data đều bỏ được.
description.en: Maintain dispatch projections with authenticated epochs, sequences and freshness. Cache eligibility does not replace durable reservations. Billing, safety and dispute history have separate governed pipelines. Rebuildable location caches do not make all location data disposable.

problem.vi: Pings nhiều hơn trip transitions và chỉ last valid fix hữu ích cho candidate lookup.

decision.en: Use in-memory latest state/spatial projections with separate durable authority and governed history.

tradeoff.en: Cache loss requires warmup/reports; drivers are not guaranteed to reconnect within one interval.

nextPressure.en: City shards create hotspots and drivers cross boundaries.

description.vi: Tách supply state, demand requests và matching. Spatial cells giới hạn candidate fan-out; consistent hashing phân phối cell owners. Đó là hai loại partitioning khác nhau: địa lý để tìm gần, hash để tìm owner. Driver movement có old membership/new membership và routing epochs; gossip membership không tự cấp linearizable reservation.
description.en: Separate supply, demand and matching. Spatial cells bound searches while hashing places cell ownership. Geography finds proximity; hashes find owners. Movement introduces old/new memberships and routing epochs. Gossip membership does not establish linearizable reservations.

problem.en: Hot cities overload shards; boundary queries need neighboring cells.

description.vi: Trip history có stable IDs, versions, legal transitions và reservation links. description.en: Trip histories need identities, versions, transitions and reservation links. Append-only versions aid auditing but do not automatically serialize writes; enforce CAS, uniqueness or transactions and verify current-state projections. Sharding, event sourcing and distributed transactions have trade-offs, not company-name mandates.

title.vi: Phục hồi trip và mobile reconnect

description.vi: Replicas/backups, writer fencing và drill là nền tảng recovery. Mobile có thể giữ last server version/command results và protected session capsule để hỗ trợ reconnect; capsule phải được authenticate, scope, version và expiry check rồi reconcile với authority. Encryption đơn thuần chưa chứng minh integrity; signed/AEAD capsule vẫn có thể stale/replayed. Không dùng phone làm nguồn duy nhất cho fare hoặc assignment finality.
description.en: Replicas, backups, fencing and drills underpin recovery. Mobile versions, command results and protected capsules can aid reconnect after authentication, scope, version, expiry and reconciliation. Encryption alone does not prove integrity; signed/AEAD capsules can still be stale or replayed. Phones are not sole fare or assignment authority.

problem.vi: Phone mất mạng và cả region có thể mất; user cần biết trip hiện tại và pending command.
problem.en: Phones and regions fail while users need current trips and pending-command outcomes.

decision.vi: Durable failover contract + reconnect status/snapshot protocol, monotonic version và replay-safe pending commands.
decision.en: Combine durable failover contracts with versioned reconnect snapshots/status and replay-safe pending commands.

tradeoff.vi: Synchronous replication tăng latency; async có RPO; client-assisted hints không tự bù mọi lost committed write.
tradeoff.en: Synchronous replication costs latency; asynchronous copies have RPO and client hints cannot restore every committed write.

nextPressure.en: More services require explicit contracts and deadline behavior.

title.vi: Geo aggregation và quote có version

description.vi: Cells hữu ích để aggregate supply/demand và phân tích shortage. H3 là một lựa chọn hexagonal hierarchical index; không phải mọi cell đều hexagon bằng nhau và logical parent không bảo đảm exact geometric containment. Pricing/dispatch có thể dùng resolutions khác. Quote cần policy/version/expiry và không phụ thuộc client suy ra giá từ màu bản đồ.
description.en: Cells help aggregate supply/demand and shortages. H3 is one hierarchical hexagonal option, not equal-sized hexagons everywhere or exact geometric parent containment. Pricing and dispatch can use different resolutions. Quotes need policies, versions and expiry rather than client inference from map colors.

problem.vi: Khu sân bay/sự kiện thay đổi supply-demand nhanh và city averages che shortage.
problem.en: Airports/events change quickly while city averages hide shortages.

decision.vi: Windowed dedup aggregation, adaptive resolution/smoothing và bounded, expiring authoritative quotes.
decision.en: Use deduplicated windows, adaptive resolution/smoothing and bounded expiring quotes.

title.vi: 6. Latest value cần authenticated epoch, sequence và TTL
title.en: 6. Latest values need authenticated epochs, sequences and TTLs

paragraphs.vi: Packet tới sau không chắc mới hơn. Server cấp active session epoch, seq tăng trong session; reject old epoch và non-increasing seq. Epoch là trusted session authority, không cho client tự tăng để thắng mọi packet khác. Duplicate không refresh receivedAt nếu không có fix mới. Device clock không đáng tin để TTL theo tương lai vô hạn; cần receipt age và capture-age/skew/accuracy policy rõ.
paragraphs.en: Later arrival does not imply newer data. Server-issued active epochs and session sequences reject stale packets; clients cannot invent epochs. Duplicates must not refresh receipt time as new fixes. Untrusted future clocks cannot extend freshness indefinitely; define receipt/capture age, skew and accuracy.

paragraphs.vi: Driver chuyển cell tạo ghost membership hoặc missing window. Có thể dùng canonical latest state + per-membership version + best-effort cleanup, query conservative cover rồi postfilter/dedup trước candidate use. Nếu query cover không đủ thì postfilter không lấy lại candidates đã miss. Khi index shard chết, warmup từ authenticated fresh reports/log theo policy và thể hiện degraded coverage; không kéo stale last-known vào live supply như chắc chắn available.
paragraphs.en: Cell movement creates ghosts or gaps. Canonical latest versions, versioned memberships and cleanup support conservative query covers followed by filtering/deduplication. Filters cannot recover candidates missed by insufficient covers. Warm failed shards from fresh authenticated reports/logs under policy and expose degraded coverage rather than counting stale positions as available.

title.vi: 7. Cells hỗ trợ tìm gần, không thay đường đi
title.en: 7. Cells support proximity rather than road routing

paragraphs.vi: Spatial hierarchy giảm candidates phải xét; road ETA mới phản ánh cầu, one-way roads, pickup restrictions và traffic. Một hex ring không mặc định exact radius cover; resolution, location, pentagon distortions và configured search bounds đều ảnh hưởng. Dùng conservative cover, exact distance/eligibility nếu contract cần, rồi road-time ranking trên coherent graph/profile/traffic generation.
paragraphs.en: Spatial hierarchies reduce candidates while road ETAs account for bridges, direction, pickup restrictions and traffic. A hex ring is not automatically an exact radius cover; resolution, location, distortions and bounds matter. Use conservative covers, required exact filters and coherent road-time ranking.

paragraphs.vi: H3 có 16 resolutions 0–15 và 12 pentagons mỗi resolution; cells không có cùng diện tích ở mọi nơi. Parent-child containment chính xác về logical index nhưng chỉ approximate geometry; đừng dùng parent ID để kết luận polygon chứa mọi child boundary. Giá trị này quan trọng khi aggregate fairness/pricing hoặc chọn query cover ở border. Có thể dùng S2/geohash/index khác nếu hiểu geometry và coverage của lựa chọn đó.
paragraphs.en: H3 has resolutions zero through fifteen and twelve pentagons per resolution; areas vary geographically. Parent/child relationships are logically exact but geometrically approximate. Do not infer complete polygon containment from parent IDs. These distinctions affect pricing aggregates and boundary covers. S2, geohash or other indexes are valid with understood geometry and coverage.

paragraphs.vi: Hash cell IDs sang machines không làm geographic demand đều. Airport, stadium hoặc concert vẫn nóng; adaptive splitting, more partitions, bounded fan-out và admission cần đo. Versioned ownership migration phải có reroute/epoch semantics; gossip liveness không chứng minh exclusive assignment owner.
paragraphs.en: Hash placement does not equalize geographic demand. Airports, stadiums and events remain hot, requiring measured splits, partitions, bounds and admission. Version ownership migrations; gossip liveness does not prove exclusive assignment authority.

title.vi: 8. Batch matching: objective và thời gian đợi
title.en: 8. Batch matching: objectives and collection delay

paragraphs.vi: Greedy xử lý từng rider theo arrival order, lấy eligible driver ETA thấp nhất đang free. Nó không luôn tối ưu tổng assignment; nhưng batch thêm collection/compute delay. Lab có hai matrices để thấy hai chuyện khác nhau: greedy regret và min-total so với min-worst. Solver maximize cardinality trước; không gọi result ít matched hơn là tốt chỉ vì total nhỏ. Unmatched users phải được báo riêng với wait/cancel/retry policy.
paragraphs.en: Greedy assigns free eligible drivers in arrival order. It need not minimize total ETA, while batching adds collection/compute delays. Two fixtures distinguish greedy regret from total-versus-worst trade-offs. Maximize cardinality first; fewer matches do not become better because their summed ETA is smaller. Track unmatched users separately.

paragraphs.vi: Nếu requests uniform trong batch window T thì mean collection delay thường T/2 dưới giả định đó; requests ở đầu window chờ gần T. Forecast, driver acceptance probability và reoffers có thể làm actual pickup khác objective. Production còn capacity, product/vehicle type, accessibility, preferences, fairness, airport queues và soon-to-finish trips. Exact tiny-fixture solver chỉ giúp hiểu, không claim optimize cả thành phố bằng exhaustive enumeration.
paragraphs.en: Uniform arrivals in a T-window give roughly T/2 mean collection under that assumption; early arrivals wait nearly T. Forecast error, acceptance and reoffers alter actual pickups. Real constraints include capacity, products, accessibility, preferences, fairness, airports and finishing trips. Tiny exact enumeration teaches objectives rather than optimizing a city.

caption.vi: Giữ đủ hai matched riders. Collection example giả định cả hai tới đầu window; chưa solve time, offer delivery, acceptance hoặc reoffers. Đây là hai matrices riêng, không đổi số của một scenario giữa chừng.
caption.en: Keep both riders matched. The collection example places both at the window start and excludes solve time, delivery, acceptance and reoffers. These are two separate matrices rather than changed values for one scenario.

title.vi: 9. Commit trip và driver reservation cùng invariant
title.en: 9. Commit trip and driver reservations under shared invariants

paragraphs.vi: T1 và T2 khác nhau đều requested, cùng D1. CAS mỗi trip có thể cùng thành công, làm D1 hai active trips. Check availability ngoài transaction không đủ do TOCTOU. Một transaction đọc/ghi trip, driver session/reservation, current offer và command result có thể enforce nếu isolation/keys/schema đúng. Cross-shard protocol cần reserve/confirm/cancel với tokens, deadlines, durable result và recovery; đừng tự hứa một distributed lock đơn giản thay hết.
paragraphs.en: Two requested trips can each CAS successfully onto one driver. Reading availability outside the commit has a TOCTOU race. Correct transaction scope, isolation and constraints can guard trips, sessions/reservations, offers and results together. Cross-shard designs need durable reserve/confirm/cancel protocols with tokens, deadlines and recovery rather than an unexplained lock.

paragraphs.vi: Old offer o1 cho D3 hết hạn, server đã phát o2 cho D2 nhưng trip vẫn requested. Check trip-state alone cho D3 accept sai trước D2. Validate exact offer ID/generation, server-clock expiry, driver/session và expected trip version. Clock UI chỉ countdown estimate; transaction authority check khi commit. Driver retry sau committed accept nhưng reply mất phải replay accepted result, không tạo charge/offer mới.
paragraphs.en: If an old D3 offer expires and D2 has a new one while the trip remains requested, state-only checks let D3 win incorrectly. Validate IDs, generations, server expiry, sessions and expected versions. UI countdowns are estimates; authority checks at commit. Lost replies replay retained acceptance rather than create new offers/charges.

caption.vi: Pseudocode cho một supported serializable transaction scope; actual schema/constraints phải enforce cả trip và driver uniqueness. Không gọi external effects trong callback có thể retry.
caption.en: Pseudocode for a supported serializable scope; actual schemas/constraints must enforce both trip and driver uniqueness. Do not call external effects inside retryable callbacks.

code.content:
BEGIN SERIALIZABLE
  result = lookup(principal_scope, command_id)
  if result exists:
    check request fingerprint; replay the retained result
  else:
    check trip state + expected version permit acceptance
    check exact current offer_id + generation + driver session
    check offer expiry using authoritative time semantics
    check driver has no active reservation under this product's capacity rule
    write trip assignment and matching driver reservation
    write command fingerprint + accepted result + notification outbox intent
COMMIT

# Retry serialization conflicts under the SAME logical command identity.
# Trip-only CAS cannot prevent D1 taking both T1 and T2.
# Availability read before the transaction is a hint, not the final guard.
# Publish notifications only through committed intent and replay-safe delivery.

title.vi: 10. ETA và quote là predictions có context
title.en: 10. ETAs and quotes are contextual predictions

paragraphs.vi: Road routing dùng graph/profile và traffic age; prediction có uncertainty theo geography, pickup geometry và time horizon. Hybrid residual model là một cách cải thiện routing baseline, không đảm bảo mọi ETA được cộng cùng một correction. Đánh giá pickup/dropoff/courier cohorts, quantiles, calibration và drift; feature/model version phải correlate với client outcome. Khi model chậm, fallback routing estimate có label/cutoff theo policy.
paragraphs.en: Routing uses graph/profile and traffic age, with uncertainty by geography, pickup geometry and horizon. Residual models can improve baselines without one universal correction. Evaluate cohorts, quantiles, calibration and drift, correlating versions with outcomes. Slow models may fall back to routing under explicit policies.

paragraphs.vi: Pricing dùng fresh supply/demand, policy caps và quote expiry. Một ratio requests/drivers đơn giản không là công thức surge thực; smoothing, lags, regulation/product policy và incentive response tạo feedback loop. Không count busy/offline driver chỉ vì còn GPS dot; dedup/replay và event-time windows cần nhất quán. Quote accepted phải có immutable terms/version hoặc explicit re-quote behavior; client fare display không thay server authority.
paragraphs.en: Pricing uses fresh supply/demand, limits and expiry. A request/driver ratio is not a real surge formula; smoothing, lag, policies and incentives create feedback. GPS dots do not make busy/offline drivers eligible. Deduplicate/window events and preserve accepted quote terms or explicit requoting; client displays do not replace server authority.

paragraphs.vi: Client giữ observed version, session cursor và pending command IDs. Reconnect fetch snapshot hoặc replay gap trong bounded retention; nếu cursor quá cũ thì explicit full refresh. Protected capsule có thể giúp recover context, nhưng signature/encryption không chứng minh freshness. Validate principal/device scope, version/expiry và compare với durable authority; anti-rollback cần retained server evidence. Không cho phone tự khai completed để quyết fare hoặc free driver.
paragraphs.en: Clients keep observed versions, cursors and pending IDs. Reconnect replays bounded gaps or explicitly refreshes expired cursors. Protected capsules may aid context recovery but signatures/encryption do not prove freshness. Validate scope, version/expiry and durable authority with anti-rollback evidence. Phones cannot unilaterally declare completion or free drivers.

paragraphs.vi: Failover cần selected replication/RPO, writer fencing và surviving capacity. Location projection warmup có thể eventually phục hồi, còn committed trip/payment results cần durability/reconciliation contract khác. Không suy “next ping sẽ sửa” thành permission bỏ committed state. Failure drills phải gồm delayed/mobile-disconnected cohorts, stale DNS/connections, replay batches và billing duplicate guards.
paragraphs.en: Failover needs explicit replication/RPO, fencing and capacity. Location warmup can be eventual while committed trip/payment results need distinct durability/reconciliation. Next pings do not justify discarding committed state. Drill disconnected phones, routing/connections, replay batches and duplicate billing protection.

items.en: Warm from authenticated reports/logs, expose coverage gaps and reject expired candidates.

items.en: Fence old writers and verify durable trips, reservations, results and versions.

title.vi: 12. Streams, ML và privacy không chen vào commit tùy tiện
title.en: 12. Keep streams, ML and privacy under explicit boundaries

paragraphs.vi: Business changes dùng transactional outbox/CDC; raw GPS intake có acceptance/loss policy riêng. Regional replication có lag/checkpoint mapping và duplicates; consumer restart/failover cần retention-aware dedup và sink fencing khi exclusive work quan trọng. Global analytics view không thay trip authority. Backfill/feature recomputation phải không vô tình charge, send receipts hoặc recreate deleted personal data.
paragraphs.en: Business changes use outbox/CDC while raw GPS has separate acceptance/loss policy. Replication adds lag, checkpoints and duplicates; restarted consumers need retention-aware dedup and sink fencing. Global analytics cannot replace trip authority. Backfills/features must not charge, resend receipts or recreate deleted personal data.

paragraphs.vi: Location history nhạy cảm dù rotate IDs hoặc aggregate. Minimize raw retention, restrict purpose/access/export, manage consent/deletion và sparse-group thresholds; không claim aggregation tự anonymous. Train/test temporal splits tránh future leakage; data/model lineage, feature freshness và release cohorts cần reproducible. ML scores có thể xếp hạng nhưng policy eligibility vẫn enforce bằng current business state.
paragraphs.en: Location history remains sensitive despite rotating IDs or aggregation. Minimize retention and govern purpose, access, exports, consent, deletion and sparse groups without claiming automatic anonymity. Temporal splits prevent leakage; lineage, freshness and release cohorts need reproducibility. Ranking never overrides eligibility authority.

title.vi: 13. Chọn storage và service boundaries theo invariant
title.en: 13. Choose storage and service boundaries by invariants

paragraphs.vi: Early relational design, sharded/custom stores và distributed transactional cores là các options có workload-specific trade-offs. Append-only versions giúp history nhưng không tự ngăn concurrent contradictory changes. Managed distributed relational storage có thể giảm coordination logic nếu schema và locality support invariants, nhưng commit/network latency, hotspots, operational dependencies và cost vẫn cần benchmark theo workload thực. Không nhầm throughput transitions/s với mọi DB transaction/s.
paragraphs.en: Relational designs, custom/sharded stores and distributed transactional cores have workload-specific trade-offs. Append-only versions do not prevent conflicting changes. Distributed transactions can simplify coordination when schemas/locality support invariants, while latency, hotspots, dependencies and costs require real workload evidence. Transition rates differ from all database transactions.

paragraphs.vi: Domain gateways thu hẹp internal surface: fulfillment owns trip/session, marketplace owns matching/quote policy, maps owns routing/ETA và payments owns money operations. Contract tests/types không tự chứng minh semantics, authorization hay deadline safety. Measure fan-out, change coupling và operational ownership; giữ modular monolith nếu nó vẫn đáp ứng các mục tiêu. Một chọn lựa phù hợp ở quy mô lớn không trở thành bắt buộc cho nhóm nhỏ.
paragraphs.en: Domain interfaces bound internals: fulfillment owns trips/sessions, marketplace matching/quotes, maps routing/ETA and payments money operations. Types/tests do not alone prove semantics, permission or deadline safety. Measure fan-out, change coupling and ownership, retaining modular applications while adequate. Large-scale choices are not small-team mandates.

title.vi: 15. Luyện giải thích một trip từ đầu đến cuối
title.en: 15. Explain one trip end to end

paragraphs.vi: Trình bày requirements/invariants trước, rồi sizing, một trace accept, hai deep dives và failure proof. Nêu rõ non-pooling; nếu interviewer thêm delivery/pooling, đổi capacity/waypoint rules thay vì giữ driver chỉ một job. Các câu dưới giúp kiểm reasoning, không phải đáp án duy nhất cho mọi geography/product.
paragraphs.en: Start with requirements/invariants, size the planes, trace acceptance, choose two deep dives and prove failures. State non-pooling assumptions; pooling/delivery change capacity and waypoint constraints. These answers test reasoning rather than prescribe one design for all products.

question.vi: Location vừa RAM có nghĩa chỉ cần một Redis node?
question.en: Does RAM fit imply one Redis node is enough?

answer.vi: Không. Raw bytes bỏ qua index/allocator/replicas, CPU/network, hotspots và failure domains. Location projection có thể rebuild nhưng committed trips không được mất theo cache. Chọn sharding/replication/warmup theo actual load và SLO.
answer.en: No. Raw sizes omit indexing, allocation, replication, CPU/network, hotspots and resilience. Rebuildable projections do not justify losing committed trips. Choose placement and warmup under actual workload/SLO evidence.

question.vi: Hai trip CAS thành công có sao không nếu driver giống nhau?
question.en: Can two successful trip CAS operations assign one driver?

answer.vi: Có thể double-book: mỗi trip row chỉ bảo vệ chính nó. Cần atomic driver reservation/capacity check và trip assignment trong transaction hoặc equivalent protocol, kèm owner token/version và replay result. Availability read ở ngoài commit không đủ.
answer.en: Yes: each trip protects itself. Atomically check/reserve driver capacity with assignment or use an equivalent protocol, retaining ownership versions and replay results. Pre-commit availability reads are insufficient.

question.vi: Một ring H3 luôn đủ query radius không?
question.en: Does one H3 ring always cover a radius?

answer.vi: Không. Geometry/resolution/location/pentagons và radius khác nhau; dùng conservative cover rồi exact filter theo contract. Road ETA còn khác metric distance. Logical H3 parent-child không exact polygon containment.
answer.en: No. Coverage varies with geometry, resolution, location, pentagons and radius. Use conservative covers and required exact filters. Road ETA differs from distance; logical hierarchy is not exact polygon containment.

question.vi: Batch matching luôn giảm thời gian chờ mọi rider?
question.en: Does batching always reduce every rider’s wait?

answer.vi: Không. Objective total khác worst/fairness và batch thêm collection/solve time. Fixture regret giảm assignment sum từ50 xuống26s, nhưng delay20s cho2riders làm total66s. Track unmatched, arrival distribution, acceptance và reoffer outcomes.
answer.en: No. Total differs from worst/fairness and batching adds delay. The regret fixture reduces assignment sum from fifty to twenty-six seconds, but twenty seconds collection per rider yields sixty-six total. Track unmatched users, arrivals and acceptance/reoffers.

question.vi: Expired offer từ D3 đến trước D2 thì trip CAS bảo vệ đủ?
question.en: Does trip CAS reject an expired D3 offer arriving before D2?

answer.vi: Không nếu trip vẫn requested. Check exact current offer ID/generation, driver/session, expected trip version và server expiry. Trip-state-only có thể gán wrong offer; driver retry sau committed accept phải replay result.
answer.en: Not while the trip remains requested. Validate current offer/generation, session, expected version and server expiry. State-only checks admit obsolete offers; committed retries return retained outcomes.

question.vi: Phone giữ encrypted trip capsule có bảo đảm không mất trip?
question.en: Does an encrypted phone capsule guarantee trip durability?

answer.vi: Không. Device có thể offline, stale hoặc replay old capsule; encryption alone không là integrity. Protected capsule cần auth/scope/version/expiry và anti-rollback evidence, reconcile với durable authority/RPO. Không thay toàn bộ replication/backup/drills bằng phone.
answer.en: No. Phones may be offline or replay stale capsules; encryption alone is not integrity. Validate protected capsules against scope, versions, expiry and anti-rollback evidence under durable authority/RPO. They do not replace replication, backups and drills.

question.vi: Model ETA tốt offline có thể thay business eligibility?
question.en: Can a good offline ETA model replace eligibility checks?

answer.vi: Không. Ranking là prediction; driver availability/session/product policy và reservation phải revalidate ở authority. Đánh giá cohorts, drift, latency và training-serving freshness; fallback model outage không được bypass assignment invariants.
answer.en: No. Predictions rank candidates while authority revalidates sessions, product eligibility and reservations. Evaluate cohorts, drift, latency and feature consistency; model fallbacks never bypass invariants.

question.vi: Vì sao payment chạy sau transaction nhưng vẫn cần outbox?
question.en: Why does post-transaction payment still need an outbox?

answer.vi: Nếu commit trip rồi crash trước publish thì payment intent mất; nếu publish trước commit thì effect có thể tồn tại cho trip chưa commit. Atomic outbox/CDC giữ intent, consumer/sink giữ unique payment identity, resolve external unknown và reconcile. “Async” không tự exactly-once.
answer.en: Crashes between commit and publication can lose intent; publishing first can act on uncommitted state. Atomic intent and sink identities preserve recovery, external uncertainty and reconciliation. Asynchrony does not imply exactly-once.
